claim: Evidence-grounded dependency-aware generation scheduling over fixed Refine Proof file slots and fixed contract ownership.

contract-composition.effect: forms directed scheduling strata after deterministic validation

operation-call.effect: forms a weak precedence constraint within one contract-composition stratum; cycles are collapsed and reported, and it is never treated as a proof dependency

support-unlock.effect: orders files within a stratum using mechanically extracted frozen-Support availability

forbidden_planner_inputs: original imports or bodies of classified human Proof theories
human Proof helper names, statements, order, consumers, dependency graph, or export plan
individual records or retrieval statistics from the Premise Database
inputs: M1 public Proof-file packages with exact selected contract statements
M2 normalized frozen-Support publication and unlock facts
M3 snapshot identity and publication counts only

model.role: propose evidence-citing contract-composition and operation-call priority edges; never emit the final schedule

scheduling.composition_cycles: collapse strongly connected components into one stratum and report them
scheduling.layer_rule: topological depth of the accepted contract-composition component graph
scheduling.serial_fallback: within each layer topologically respect acyclic operation-call edges; among currently ready operation components sort by support-unlock count descending, operation-call outgoing count descending, then file_slot ascending
scheduling.same_layer_meaning: no accepted contract-composition ordering separates the files; acyclic operation-call edges still constrain the serial fallback and do not assert proof dependency or independence
